lifecycle.story: Ember is insured by Ironclad under a mortality-and-fertility policy. Coverage continues only while a licensed veterinarian attests proof-of-life every 30 days; any sale additionally requires a fresh liveness credential issued within 72 hours of transfer. Rosa cannot attest her own horse.
kernelExpectations: liveness credentials carry a freshness window — a stale attestation fails closed at the gate
the issuer must be a TIR-approved veterinary issuer for the ANIMAL_HEALTH scope — a self-attestation by the custodian is rejected
the liveness credential lives privately in the custodian's wallet; 'is Ember certified alive within 30 days?' answers in one bit without revealing the vet, the visit, or the mare
sale escrow holds until a liveness credential issued within 72h is presented — the vault releases the credential, never the care history
